tasks.register<JavaExec>("runJavaClientConformance") {
    group = "verification"
    description = "Runs the official Java ACP client against the pinned TypeScript agent."
    dependsOn(tasks.testClasses)
    classpath = sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    mainClass.set("io.github.diodeme.ji.acp.v1.JavaClientConformance")
    args(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.file("tooling/acp-conformance/v1-agent.mjs").asFile.absolutePath)
}
